title: Soviet missiles brought online

plain: In the 1960s, nuclear missiles in the Soviet Union are said to have been switched on by themselves while unidentified objects were present, much like reports from American missile bases. A retired US Army colonel named Karl Nell says records released under a US law that lets anyone request government files, along with witness accounts, back this up, which would mean the same thing happened on both sides of the Cold War.
